title: BC Friday Tips #64 Filter Tokens Codeunit
summary: The Filter Tokens codeunit enables converting text input into date filters with shortcuts like T for Today, matching FlowFilter behavior for consistent user experience in extensions.
key_points: Text fields can be converted to date filters using the Filter Tokens codeunit
Supports date filter shortcuts similar to FlowFilters (e.g., T for Today)
Validates user input before converting to proper date filter format
Maintains consistent behavior with standard FlowFilter functionality

quotes.text: You can turn a Text field into a Date Filter, just like a FlowFilter
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the core capability to extend text input handling to match standard filter behavior

quotes.text: Use the Filter Tokens codeunit to validate user input and convert it into a proper date filter
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the practical purpose and method for implementing this feature in extensions
